newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PCI Bank to launch US$75 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: PCI Bank to launch US$75 mln FRCD.

text.p: The following issue was announced by Chase Manhattan Asia.
It will be formally launched on October 28.
